english.title: Furnish false / misleading information - Animals and Animal Products (Import and Export) Regulations 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) furnished to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a person acting in the execution of the Animals and Animal Products (Import and Export)(England) Regulations 2006 information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE OR MISLEADING INFORMATION..), which you knew to be false or misleading
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 32(c) and 34(4) of the Animals and Animal Products (Import and Export)(England) Regulations 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
furnished information to a person acting in the execution
of Animals and Animal Products (Import and Export)(England) Regs 06
which he/she knew to be false or misleading

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 3 provides that, except where otherwise expressly provided, these regulations shall be enforced by the local authority.
(ii) A corresponding set of regulations applies to Wales - see S.I. 2006/1536.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine

Time limit on prosecutions:
None.
